title: Pimps' Cadillac funerals and nightclub owners
summary: Cadillac funerals for pimps and club owners who bought rounds in each other's bars.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: And there was another little bar there where one of the big-name pimps, whose name was Fortree(?) at the time... I can remember once when one of his friends passed, they had a Cadillac funeral. They had 26 Cadillacs. You know, when one of the pimps died, they'd have a Cadillac funeral, a Lincoln Continental funeral. They'd really do it up, you know! [LAUGHS] You couldn't be in the funeral unless you had one of those cars.

And those guys, they used to really live it up. Like, nightclub owners used to do things that they don't do now. They'd go and patronize each other. The guy would come in and he'd set up the whole bar. Which is nothing but promotion! -- you know. And they really-really-really lived it up.
